channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon CloudFront now supports AWS Lambda Web Functions as an origin
item.description: Starting today, you can deliver web applications built on AWS Lambda Web Functions through CloudFront's global edge network. (2 sources: aws, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
item.description: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places. (6 sources: cloudflare, hackernews, javascriptweekly, lobsters, reactstatus, rprogramming)

item.title: Amazon DCV releases version 2026.0 with RHEL 10 support and new clients
item.description: Amazon DCV 2026.0 is now available, adding support for RHEL 10, Rocky Linux 10, CentOS 10, and Ubuntu 26.04 along with a new macOS client and updated Windows and Linux clients. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Security Hub now supports resource criticality for prioritization
item.description: Today, AWS Security Hub adds resource criticality to exposure prioritization, helping central security teams focus on the exposures that threaten their most business-critical resources. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon ECS adds LiveTaskCount and removes the charge for RunningTaskCount metric
item.description: Today, Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) announces LiveTaskCount, a new ECS service metric that reports how many tasks are actively running in your service, available to all customers at no additional charge. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Agent Registry now supports custom metadata for registry records
item.description: AWS Agent Registry is the centralized, governed catalog for agents, MCP servers, agent skills, gateways, and custom resources within your organization. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now helps users find their accessible resources in the Deadline Cloud monitor
item.description: AWS Deadline Cloud now lets users who have access to specific queues, fleets, or jobs, rather than an entire farm, find the resources they can reach directly from the Deadline Cloud monitor. (1 source: aws)
